note: BH-6894: the cron line runs pr-url-reconcile.sh --dispatch, which starts one run per project (bin/lib/project-lanes.sh). Each project starts at a stable offset inside this window. 120, not 540: the lane runs at :03 and its links must be ready for the merge sweep at :06. 0 starts every project run at once. A non-number falls back to 120 with one log line.
